notes: Bridle a partir do motor (clica no motor, depois nos pre-rigs/vigas/truss; botão direito termina) e pontas/vértice que se arrastam; motor invertido por cima do truss; Fixture ID e power thru; stock pela biblioteca/GDTF; colunas dos Layouts ajustáveis; a app aberta do pacote descarregado instala-se sozinha.
notesEn: Bridle from a hoist (click the hoist, then the pre-rigs/beams/trusses; right-click finishes) with draggable anchors/apex; inverted hoist above the truss; fixture ID and power thru; stock from the library/GDTF; resizable Layouts columns; the app opened from the downloaded package installs itself.
